## Prior on coefficients


Extensions of g-prior mixtures to GLMs include using the observed or expected information matrix
evaluated at the maximum-likelihood (ML) as the prior covariance (Hansen and Yu, 2003; Wang and George, 2007; Li and Clyde, 2016).
